reviews.title: Shouldn’t Have to Wonder If Messages Are Missing
reviews.text:
I wanted to share my experience because it hasn’t matched the app’s high ratings.

The app worked fine for about a week, but then messages started failing to send without warning. Someone I had been talking to through the app reached out to me, which is how I realized my messages had not been going through. I replied successfully, but the very next message failed again. My biggest concern is that I have no way of knowing whether this only affects sending or if I’m also intermittently missing incoming messages from other people. That uncertainty is a serious problem for a messaging app.

I tried reporting the bug, but support is limited to an AI assistant unless you submit a support request. The AI asked for diagnostic information, but due to a bug in the iOS app, I couldn’t paste text into either the AI chat or the support form. Tapping the text field simply dismissed the keyboard instead of showing the paste menu. After submitting the request manually, I received an email with a blank subject line that only said “RE:”.

This is a privacy focused messaging app, so technical competence matters. If basic functionality and the support experience have this many issues, it makes me question whether I can trust the service with something as important as my privacy and data security. If these issues are resolved, I’ll gladly update this review, but based on my experience so far, I can’t recommend the app.

reviews.title: A bit buggy
reviews.text:
I’ve used the app for quite a few years and it’s been very helpful. Overall, it’s been a dependable service that gets the job done. 

However, lately there are a few persistent bugs that I experience. I often doubt get calls going through to my iPhone. When I test it myself by calling from a different phone, the calls to my Burner number goes right to voicemail, but calling my iPhone directly rings as expected. Even the test call feature in the Burner app goes right to voicemail. The Burner app setting to silence incoming calls is turned off. 

I’m also not getting notifications for all of my new messages. Often, when I open the app, I have many unread messages and suddenly have a notification badge appear. But only when opening the app first.

reviews.title: Buggy, unreliable, bad customer service
reviews.text:
This app used to work great for my business, but for the past month or so, it’s been nonstop issues that never get fixed. I’ve missed important business texts, or my texts are very delayed or never go through. Notifications also never go away. There’s been at least two updates that supposedly were for bug fixes but they have fixed nothing. 

I’ve done all the recommended troubleshooting in the help guides and even mentioned it when I contacted support but all I got back was a generic message that just told me to do the troubleshooting… which I had said I’d done already. So it’s clear they don’t actually read your emails, or it’s not actually monitored by real people. 

I made the mistake of paying for a year-long subscription so I’m just warning people not to make the same mistake I did thinking this is a reliable app that you can do business with. Terrible app with terrible customer service and support
